summary: Item 'TRAINING SCHOOL WINS PRAISE FOR "NEWSPAPER"' reports that the school publication of the New Jersey State Manual Training and Industrial School for Colored Youth near Bordentown was given favorable mention "in the grading of school papers announced by the Columbia University Scholastic Press Association." The Ironsides Echo, published monthly and edited by students, "won second place award among the technical and agricultural high schools." The gradings "are said to represent 860 publications, from high schools, preparatory schools and academies" - 860 is the scope of the association's gradings, not the field the Echo placed against. Leon Snead is named as student editor. The association announced the grading; Governor A. Harry Moore had no role in it and appears only in a separate Atlantic County Board of Elections item in the adjacent column of the same page. The page also carries other unrelated county political and news items.
